root_cause.text: In dpu_runtime_suspend, calling dev_pm_opp_set_rate(dev, 0) reduces the MMCX rail voltage to MIN_SVS while the core clock frequency remains at its highest rate (since clocks are disabled afterward), creating a voltage/frequency mismatch that persists after runtime resume and can cause instability or system crash.
root_cause.evidence: The patch removes the line `dev_pm_opp_set_rate(dev, 0)` from `dpu_runtime_suspend`, and the CVE description explains that this call drops the rail voltage without adjusting the clock frequency, leading to a mismatch that may cause instability.
